name: Banc d'Arguin National Park
subtitle: Banc d'Arguin National Park covers about 1.2 million hectares of the Mauritanian coast, half of it marine.

facts.label: Area
facts.value: 1,200,000 hectares, half marine and half continental

facts.label: Residents
facts.value: Eight coastal villages with about 1,400 Imraguen, who live exclusively from fishing

facts.label: Fishing rules
facts.value: The management plan prohibits fishing within the park except by resident Imraguen, and bans engines for their fishing except for research and transport of persons

facts.label: Wintering birds
facts.value: Some three million birds of about 300 species in winter

facts.label: Constraint
facts.value: The total absence of fresh water is the main limiting factor (Ramsar sheet)

parts.text: Banc d'Arguin National Park covers about 1.2 million hectares of the Mauritanian coast, half of it marine. It was created by the Mauritanian government in 1976. Eight villages of Imraguen fishermen live inside it, and fishing there is reserved to them under the park's management plan.
